propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while maintaining false defaults in reusable configuration schema.
End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove that material changes trigger invalidation and unchanged re-reviews do not propagate further invalidation.

Configuration keys must already exist in VerifyConfig, _SECTIONS[verify], and tests/golden/config_surface.json before rebar.toml is edited; no eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, or stored relation migration occurs.

Public lifecycle surfaces must demonstrate enable/disable/re-enable behavior, depends_on and blocks normalization, execution-phase plan review adaptation, in_progress-to-open reset, code-only close freshness, and deleted/archived target handling.

Real CLI invocation without dry-run bypass must validate four fixture cases: legacy unpinned attestation claim succeeds (exit 0, open to in_progress), current pinned attestation with execution review closes successfully (exit 0, in_progress to closed), stale material pin drift rejects operations (exit 1, unchanged status, names canonical target and stale-pin-drift reason), and planning-phase close review rejection instructs review-plan (exit 1, in_progress unchanged).

Structured JSON evidence object must confirm both config fields true, all observed exit codes and status transitions match expected values, required reason tokens present, and all four test cases pass deterministically.
